description.text: Deep inside a concrete road tunnel, the darkness is near total; only a thin rim of cold light traces the bodywork of

as it waits in place. The tunnel walls are rough and close, with faint service lamps far back throwing amber pools onto damp asphalt. The car noses forward at a crawl, its headlamps swelling from dim discs into broad white beams that push the gloom aside. Dust motes and exhaust haze drift through the light; the tyres press a faint sheen from the tunnel floor. The movement changes the scene from a motionless dark silhouette into a visible forward creep, the beams igniting the space ahead.
A low engine idle thickens into a rough rumble beneath a faint tyre hiss and deep tunnel echo.
noses forward out of the blackness.
Its headlamps swell into broad white beams, lighting damp asphalt and drifting haze.
The engine note rises as the tyres begin to roll faster.

surges out of the dark and sweeps into pale open daylight, the concrete arch falling behind. Its headlamp beams thin against the brighter air as the body catches the cool outdoor light and a clearer silhouette emerges. The road surface brightens under the tyres, and the last tunnel shadow slides away. The change is decisive: the car breaks fully free of the blackness into open light, leaving the tunnel receding behind it.
surges through the tunnel mouth into pale daylight.
The engine note climbs and a wind rush opens around the car as it leaves the tunnel.
Cool daylight spreads across the road surface as the tunnel arch recedes behind.
The deep tunnel echo fades behind the rising outdoor air.
